steps.name: a_hover_stall
steps.desc: pointer over a market stall on the plaza edge: a chalk ring round the stall and the pill 'Drag to move this piece, click to pick it'

steps.name: b_picked_stall
steps.desc: clicked: the stall is ringed in gold and the pane shows Market stall with Swap and Remove

steps.name: c_carry_stall
steps.desc: dragging the stall to open ground: a gold ring at the place, the place it left a calm ring, 'Release to put it here'

steps.name: d_pinned_stall
steps.desc: released: the stall stands where it was put; the pane says it was placed by hand and offers Put back

steps.name: e_swapped
steps.desc: R over a barrel: the next of its four draws, pinned (Swap itself is covered by the unit tests)

steps.name: f_refused_house
steps.desc: dragging a barrel over a house: the ring turns salmon and the pill says why; the release changes nothing

steps.name: g_removed
steps.desc: a barrel removed: gone from the yard, the pane offers 'Put back 1 taken away'

steps.name: h_720_pane
steps.desc: 1280x720: a picked piece, the whole pane with Swap, Put back and Remove and the Put back taken-away button

steps.title: villages4 look
steps.intro: Touchable furnishings in the Village tool
